snippet.title: Seahorse Soap Patrol Trailer
snippet.description:
A squad of seahorses must send polluters packing!

When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes, blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! 

Pick up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.

Out now on PlayStation, Switch, and XBOX!
